definitions.explanation: Childish word for urine or the act of urinating. Universally understood and commonly used with children, but also used casually by adults.

examples.japanese: おしっこ⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧くる。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧おしっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らして→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧しまった。

notes:
REGISTER: Childish but socially acceptable. Commonly used when speaking to or about children, and casually among adults in informal settings.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- おしっこ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to pee)
- おしっこ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go pee)
- おしっこ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{漏|も}らす→漏らす：02436_morasu⟧ (to wet oneself)

ALTERNATIVES: More formal terms include ⟦{小便|しょうべん}→小便：28713_shouben⟧ (crude/direct) and {尿|にょう} (medical). Polite expressions include ⟦お{手洗|てあら}い→お手洗い：02861_otearai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to the restroom).
